--[[
Dear Kibatan,
dokuji no radar wo tsunde mimashita.
radar ha missile radar x2 desu. FOV X ga hiroi radar to FOV Y ga hiroi radar wo kumiawasete imasu. saitama demo tamani tsukau kousei desu ne.
radar wo tsumu tameni, zoukei ni sukoshidake tewo kuwaemashita. gomennasai.
sorekara, yakkyou ni yoru shahei wo kaiketsu suru tame, toumei na block wo haichi shitari, main no MG wo jouge hanten sasetari shimashita. sonotame, AP ga tsukaenaku natte shimai mashita.
K no kagai nouryoku to AP no dantou hakai nouryoku, dochiramo mochiawaseta monoga saiteki desuga, sou umakuha ikanai mono desu.
hitotsume no lua block niha filter to TWS ga haitte imasu.
mokuhyou jouhou wo AA FCR kara eta baai, sono mokuhyou wo yuusenn shitsutsu, hokano mokuhyou no kyouido mo hantei shi, yuusen mokuhyou wo uchiotoshita baai ha kou kyouido mokuhyou wo jibunde sagashite kougeki wo keizoku shimasu.
mochiron, kore ha douhoukou karano houwa kougeki ni taiou suru tame no sochi nanode, tahoukou kara utareru bunn niha kinou shinai kamo.
mokuhyou jouhou wo Surface FCR kara eta baai,filter ya kyouido hantei nadoha habuki, dandou keisanki tantai de dousa shimasu.
dokuji sousaku ha missile radar deha kibishii kedo, dekireba dokuritsu shita system ni shitaiyone.
seinou to shite ha, Neza I nara kakujitsuni, Neza II nara 70% no kakuritsu de gekitsui kanoudesu.
zentai teki ni,
- kaihi kidou missile no gekitsui = SeaRAM ijou no seinou to marge kouritsu - douhoukou karano houwa kougeki taisho = 1 byou kannkaku 8 hatsu ijou no gekitsui - tahoukou karano houwa kougeki taisho = douji 4 hatsu made no gekitsui
wo mezashite kaihatsu shimashita.
kore de SeaRAM wo tsumu hitsuyou ha mohaya nai ne!
Sincerely, Rocamisakitohko
]]

function GtoDir(x,y,z) x,y,z=x-GunX,y-GunY,z-GunZ x,y,z=rotZ(x,y,z,-EZ) x,y,z=rotY(x,y,z,-EY) x,y,z=rotX(x,y,z,-EX) x,y,z=x,y,z-0.25 yaw,pitch=AT(x,y),AT(z/(x^2+y^2)^0.5) return yaw,pitch end function rotX(x,y,z,EX) x,y,z=x,y*cos(-EX)-z*sin(-EX),y*sin(-EX)+z*cos(-EX) return x,y,z end function rotY(x,y,z,EY) x,y,z=x*cos(-EY)-y*sin(-EY),x*sin(-EY)+y*cos(-EY),z return x,y,z end function rotZ(x,y,z,EZ) x,y,z=x*cos(EZ)-z*sin(EZ),y,x*sin(EZ)+z*cos(EZ) return x,y,z end function D3(x,y,z) return (x*x+y*y+z*z)^0.5 end function Dot3(x,y,z,a,b,c) return x*a+y*b+z*c end function getY(v,t) return -g*t/drag+(g/drag+v)*(1-m.exp(-drag*t))/drag end function getTime(v,x) return -m.log(1-drag*x/v)/drag end function calc(D,E) local t,a,w,h=0,E,D*cos(E),D*sin(E) for i=1,10 do local vx,vy=vel*cos(a),vel*sin(a) t=getTime(vx,w) if t>lifeSpan then a=E return a,t,false end y=getY(vy,t) if y>=h-error then return a,t,true end
a=a+E-atan(y,w) end a=E return a,t,false end function clamp(a,mn,mx) tf=false if a>=mn and a<=mx then tf=true end return m.min(m.max(a,mn),mx),tf end function CLMP(a,b) return m.min(m.max(a,-b),b) end
